title: Draw → Bake → Play
blurb: Import builds authoring Auth cards (not login). Bake freezes GraphData. Play never opens the pretty map.

chapters.title: Hello
chapters.text: Welcome to the cooking show. Recipe is your map. Oven is the baker. Dinner plate is the robot tick. Same three steps every time.
chapters.deep: Import and bake are pure authoring. Runtime only consumes Blob Asset Reference Graph Data. Graph Authoring or Graph Authoring Buffer reference Grove Auth Graph, never the source my graph file.

chapters.title: Main path
chapters.text: You draw the pretty map. The importer builds an Auth box — a frozen card deck of Root, inputs, outputs, and nodes. Authoring on an entity only points at that Auth box. The bake oven reads the Auth box and freezes a brick. Play never opens the pretty map again.
chapters.deep: Source GroveGraph is imported by GroveImporter into GroveAuthGraph plus node subassets. GraphAuthoring references the auth main object. GraphBakingSystem calls Auth.Create to emit GraphData. Runtime IGraphReference holds only the blob.

chapters.title: Start door
chapters.text: The start door rule: exactly one Input wire must touch the first action box. Zero starts or two starts means the importer yells.
chapters.deep: Report Root Candidate Errors fires if multiple Input to execution roots exist, or if top-level execution exists with no Input root. Untyped Graph Toolkit variables never become runtime Inputs or Outputs.

chapters.title: Extras
chapters.text: Variants pick a branch while baking, so unpicked paths disappear from the brick. The backpack holds live memory after bake.
chapters.deep: Bake hash includes graph identity, selected variant values, instance overrides, and Version Key. Grove Variant Auth Register Stripped Nodes removes unselected branches from the blob.

start_door.short: Start door check. The Auth box only gets a Root if exactly one Input boundary connects to an execution node.
start_door.deep: CollectRootCandidates: exactly one Input variable resolving to GroveExecutionAuth.
start_door.label: Start door

bad_root.short: Import error path. Fix the wires.
bad_root.deep: Import validation failure for entry shape.
bad_root.label: Oops

source_map.short: Pretty map. Graph Toolkit source you edit. Humans draw here; bakers do not read this file at runtime.
source_map.deep: GroveGraph source asset (.mygraph). Editor only. Not the baker input.
source_map.label: Source map

bake_step.short: Bake oven. Reads the Auth box, applies variants and overrides, freezes a GraphData brick.
bake_step.deep: GraphBakingSystem. Calls Auth.Create with instance values and variant selection.
bake_step.label: Bake

it_runs.short: It runs. Robot can Execute the brick.
it_runs.deep: I Graph Reference Graph property holds the blob.
it_runs.label: It runs!

importer.short: Importer. Reads the pretty map once and builds the Auth box plus node sub-cards.
importer.deep: GroveImporter ScriptedImporter. Creates auth subassets and sets Root from Input boundary candidates.
importer.label: Importer

fix_wire.short: Reimport after you fix the start door.
fix_wire.deep: Reimport after fixing Input to execution wiring.
fix_wire.label: Fix wire

auth_graph.short: Auth graph. Imported GroveAuthGraph plus node Auth cards. Authoring — not authentication or login.
auth_graph.deep: GroveAuthGraph ScriptableObject main asset from GroveImporter. Fields Root, Inputs, Outputs, Nodes as GroveAuth subassets. GraphAuthoring references this asset, never the .mygraph at bake time. Auth means authoring intermediate.
auth_graph.label: Auth graph

variants.deep: Dictionary of Grove Variant Auth to selected branch.
variants.label: Variants

authoring.short: Authoring component. Points at an Auth graph plus optional overrides. Not login.
authoring.deep: GraphAuthoring of TAuth comma TComponent. References Auth, registers bake deps, writes GraphBakingData.
authoring.label: Authoring

backpack.short: Backpack and overrides live near play.
backpack.deep: Instance values and Grove State initialize bake.
backpack.label: Backpack

you.short: You. The designer who wants a brain on the entity.
you.deep: Author intent. Creates Grove Graph asset.
you.label: Kid / you
